summary: Corrects contour nesting and recovery integrity, checks current setup and cancellation during output, bounds DXF expansion and editor history, and speeds planning, navigator rendering and simulation.
warning: Potential output change: newly imported or reanalyzed affected contours can receive corrected exterior/hole roles, cut ordering and automatic compensation. Review kept material and exact generated controller output with the installed setup before machining. Installed posts and saved revisions are never rewritten. Revision-deletion and project-purge recovery journals now use version 2 with exact file fingerprints; older releases cannot recover them. Complete recovery in this release before downgrading. Unknown file contents or legacy committed deletion journals without fingerprints now block recovery while preserving files and journals instead of overwriting or guessing which files to delete. Oversized or excessively complex DXF input now fails as a complete import instead of expanding without a bound; simplify or split the source. Undo/redo share a limit of 50 snapshots and an estimated 32 MiB; old or oversized steps may be unavailable with an explicit message.

checklist.schema: App version advances once to 0.0.689. UPID, post package, engine API, execution-plan, machine-package, workbench catalog, project and saved-revision schemas are unchanged. Only revision-deletion and project-purge transaction journals advance to v2; legacy v1 records remain readable with conservative recovery rules.
checklist.events: Execution event kinds and fields are unchanged. Corrected containment can change newly analyzed contour roles and child-before-parent ordering, which can change the resulting motion and compensation sequence. Existing saved document/revision snapshots are preserved.
checklist.capabilities: No post capabilities are added or relaxed. Controller generation rechecks the exact stored physical machine, active binding, post installation and resolved properties under the workbench lock. Generic intentionally fixed revision candidates remain supported. Cancellation and draft-version checks occur immediately before journal writing. Agent DXF replacement preparation invalidates the previous handle after workbench-version validation, including when the replacement fails; existing tool arguments stay unchanged.
checklist.auditAndOutput: Motion audits, exact post formatting, encoding, numbering, wrappers and no-default-feed behavior remain enforced. Corrected automatic compensation can change output for newly analyzed affected geometry. Ranking closed-contour start candidates preserves deterministic tie rules while eliminating full-chain copies per candidate. Committed revisions and artifacts retain truthful receipts with an additive cleanupPending diagnostic when journal removal fails. Simulation incrementally tracks exact cut coverage and outstanding segments, preserving release events and tiny uncut gaps. DXF limits abort the complete import with a typed diagnostic; accepted geometry and post auditing rules are unchanged. Metadata fields are limited to 4,096 characters and expanded data to a conservative 64 MiB estimate, including repeated INSERT provenance. Spline depth exhaustion rejects the complete import instead of omitting geometry.
checklist.installationAndStorage: Installed packages and old revisions are not migrated or rewritten. Recovery and immediate rollback preserve unknown exact contents and journals, including BOM differences and unrecognized partial JSON. New destructive recovery journals fingerprint every owned file and preflight deletion sets. Legacy committed deletions with remaining unverified files block rather than guess. Backup validates BOM-prefixed JSON without changing exact payloads or hashes. Editor external-program saves compare loaded text under lock. Both cache and folder adapters are covered. A failed browser write probe retains readable existing cache data and normal validation/recovery instead of hiding projects behind a temporary workbench. Valid full caches can still be backed up. History limits affect only transient undo/redo, not saved files. The unused legacy dxf dependency and two unused transitive packages were removed without changing other dependency versions.
checklist.verification: Final integrated verification: 198 unit/integration files and 1,942 tests passed; Chromium end-to-end suite 80 passed and one optional preseeded smoke test skipped. TypeScript/production build, public documentation checks, generated authoring-doc parity and release check passed. All three UPID fixtures and all three unchanged Robofil 2.6.0 post fixtures passed; complete package validation passed. New regressions cover recovery integrity, exact containment, DXF resource/metadata/spline limits with no partial imports, bounded atomic history, cache quota startup and backup, exact simulation coverage and deterministic work budgets, and failed agent preparation invalidation. Independent Astra High reviews drove additional recovery, spline-depth and metadata-amplification fixes. No physical-machine verification is implied.

testedPosts.scope: All three unchanged Robofil 2.6.0 post conformance fixtures and complete machine-package validation passed. No physical-machine verification.

publicNotes.summary: More reliable contour roles and recovery, bounded import and undo memory, and faster editing, planning and simulation.
changes: Concave contours and holes close to circular boundaries use exact containment when new geometry is analyzed. Review automatic kept material and generated output after importing or reanalyzing affected geometry.
Recovery preserves unexpected file contents and pending recovery records. Pending deletion uses file fingerprints; unresolved older deletions remain blocked with their original files available.

Controller export checks the current stored machine setup and stops a cancelled or stale request before revision writing begins. Completed revisions retain their receipt even when recovery cleanup must be retried.
Backups accept valid UTF-8 BOM-prefixed catalogs while retaining their exact original strings and checksums.
Saving an external program detects changes made to its editable file since opening. Reopen the project to review those changes before saving again.
Endpoint inspection reuses document lookups and closed-contour planning avoids allocating a complete path for every possible starting segment.
DXF input is limited to 16 MiB with shared block, geometry and spline complexity budgets. A limit rejects the complete import with guidance; no partial project is saved.
Undo and redo share 50 snapshots and an estimated 32 MiB history budget. Notifications explain when old steps or an oversized state cannot be retained.
A full but readable browser cache keeps existing projects and backup access available, with a warning that writes may fail.
Navigator rendering reuses operation/action lookups and bounds. Simulation tracks completed cuts incrementally while retaining exact gaps and release timing.
A failed replacement agent DXF preview clears its previous preparation. Prepare and review the intended drawing again before importing.
publicNotes.compatibility: Installed packages and saved revisions remain intact. New analysis can change contour roles and automatic compensation, so review exact output with the installed setup. Pending v2 deletion recovery requires this release; finish it before downgrading. Conflicting or unverified recovery data is preserved and blocks writes. Oversized/complex DXF files may now require simplification or splitting. Transient undo/redo history is limited; preserve a saved/exported copy for long editing sessions.
publicNotes.action: Reload the app and review the active setup before generating output. If cleanup is pending, reopen the workbench and reuse the saved revision or artifact; do not generate another merely to retry downloading. Preserve workbench files, browser data and recovery records when a conflict is reported.
